userStories.title: Weekly buckets and per-bucket means
acceptanceCriteria: Sessions in the last 90 days are bucketed by ISO week
Weekly mean is computed for engagement_rate, delegation_rate, independence_rate, and the 6 dim scores
Weeks with fewer than 2 sessions are excluded from the fit but retained for cost-ledger rendering
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Significant-slope gate using stderr
acceptanceCriteria: Slope and standard error are computed via least-squares over weekly means
A slope is `significant` only if |slope| >= 1.5 * stderr AND |slope| >= 0.05 per week
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Label mapping per Section 7.2
acceptanceCriteria: Labels Learning, Growing autonomy, Steady, Drifting, Atrophying, Reading are assigned exactly according to the table in Section 7.2
Reading is returned when fewer than 4 weekly buckets have data
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Hysteresis on label transitions
acceptanceCriteria: A new label differs from the previous week's label only when |slope| >= 2.0 * stderr on the relevant axis
Otherwise the previous week's label is retained
On identical input, the label does not change between two consecutive runs
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: LLM-generated headline sentence <= 180 chars
acceptanceCriteria: One short LLM call takes label, slope numbers, and bucket count as inputs and returns a single sentence
Output is truncated to 180 chars
The label is not invented by the LLM: the prose is constrained to paraphrase the supplied label
